sources.snippet: DDRNet23Slim is a machine learning model that segments an image into semantic classes, specifically designed for road-based scenes. It is designed for the application of self-driving cars. This model is an implementation of DDRNet23-Slim found here. This repository provides scripts to run DDRNet23-Slim on Qualcomm® devices.
